pages.title: Fruit and potions
pages.text: Craft a mana fruit from an apple and mana crystals. Eating it permanently raises reserve capacity, up to the default growth cap of 1024. Attributes and server settings can adjust capacity.
Brew a mana crystal into an awkward potion for Mana Recovery. Redstone extends duration; glowstone improves level. The effect boosts only the fixed part of regeneration, not its percentage term.
